mapper.sql: id, order_no, user_id, hospital_id, setmeal_id, doctor_id, order_date, order_status, create_time, cancel_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_no, user_id, hospital_id, setmeal_id, doctor_id, order_date, order_status, create_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{hospitalId}, #{setmealId}, #{doctorId}, #{orderDate}, #{orderStatus}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, o.hospital_id, o.setmeal_id, o.doctor_id, o.order_date, o.order_status, o.create_time, o.cancel_time, h.name AS hospital_name, s.name AS setmeal_name, s.type AS setmeal_type, s.price AS setmeal_price, doc.real_name AS doctor_name, doc.department AS doctor_department FROM orders o LEFT JOIN hospital h ON h.id = o.hospital_id LEFT JOIN setmeal s ON s.id = o.setmeal_id LEFT JOIN doctor doc ON doc.id = o.doctor_id WHERE o.id = #{id}
SELECT order_no FROM orders WHERE order_no LIKE CONCAT(#{datePrefix}, '%') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
